title: Item Frame Cache
description: Cache Item Frames regardless of server's simulation distance.
body:
Many servers set a low Simulation Distance to save on performance. This causes Item Frames, which are entities, to vanish as soon as you step a few blocks away, leaving your storage rooms or galleries looking empty.

This mod aims to solve this issue by storing item frames sent from the server into your local disk to ensure they are always visible, even when the server stops sending them.

**Demo**: Item Frames remain while the empty ones disappear.
